name: Server not reachable
description: The backend or the frontend dev server did not answer. Check that both run.

name: UI timeout
description: An element or page did not come in time. Often a slow machine or a changed selector.

name: Rate limit (HTTP 429)
description: The backend refused too many requests. The local profile must allow many logins.

name: Product defect (wrong result)
description: A check failed: the application gave a different result than expected.

name: Test defect (code error)
description: The test code threw an error before its checks finished.
